content.text: Let me try updating the ticket again:

input.note:
Cause: The smtp-relay service was moved to the shared-infra namespace on Sunday, but notification-worker still uses short hostname "smtp-relay". DNS resolution fails within the notify namespace.

Evidence: Pod logs show "lookup smtp-relay on 10.96.0.10:53: no such host"

Fix: Update SMTP_HOST from "smtp-relay" to "smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local" [cite: tasks/administer-cluster/namespaces#understanding-namespaces-and-dns-0] to access services across namespaces using the fully qualified domain name.
